description: Parse work shifts (day/date, start, end, break minutes; handles overnight shifts) into daily and weekly totals, regular vs overtime hours, gross pay and optional 5/6/15-minute rounding. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/hours-calculator.

defaultBreakMinutes.description: Default break minutes for lines without one (optional)

overtimeAfterHours.description: Weekly hours threshold for overtime, e.g. 40 (optional)

roundMinutes.description: Round each day to 0, 5, 6 or 15 minutes

shifts.description: Shifts one per line (or JSON array), e.g. Mon 9:00 17:30 30
